topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: This is just... I don’t even know what this is. We planned everything, every stupid detail of our lives, together. We said forever, remember? I just saw you yesterday and you were all smiles, not a single hint. And now this? Moving across the country like it’s some casual decision? How are you just telling me now? We were supposed to grow old in that stupid apartment we both hate but love. You can’t just up and leave, not now, not when we’ve been through everything. What about our plans? What am I supposed to do when you’re gone? How am I supposed to deal with all of this without you here? This isn’t how it was supposed to be.
